messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — spotted a couple of broken bits in the SDK examples for streaming+pagination. PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/482

maria: thanks — which examples exactly?

alex: python streaming pagination sample and the TS resumable cursor example. The python example still shows the old `cursor` field; we moved to `resume_token`. Also backoff logic is pretty naive.

sam: can you paste the snippet? I can push a small patch.

alex: sure, current Python snippet in docs:```python
resp = client.stream.generate(model="xlarge", input_stream=my_iter)
for chunk in resp:
    if chunk.type == "cursor":
        cursor = chunk.value
```
should be more like:```python
resp = client.stream.generate(model="xlarge", input_stream=my_iter)
for chunk in resp:
    if chunk.type == "resume_token":
        resume_token = chunk.value
# client-side backoff on transient errors
```

toni: for backoff let's use exponential with jitter. Add small helper in examples:```python
def backoff_sleep(attempt):
    sleep = min(2 ** attempt, 10) * (0.5 + random.random()/2)
    time.sleep(sleep)
```

maria: TS side also needs `resumeToken` rename + brief note about resuming across reconnects. Current TS example:```ts
for await (const event of client.stream({ model: 'xlarge' })) {
  if (event.type === 'cursor') cursor = event.value
}
```
should be `resumeToken` and show `client.resumeStream({ resumeToken })` pattern.

sam: I'll update both snippets and include unit-test-like pseudo example to validate token roundtrip. Any preference for wording: "resume token" vs "resume_token"? Keep casing consistent per SDK (snake_case in python, camelCase in TS/Go).

toni: yep — follow SDK idioms. python: `resume_token`, ts/go: `resumeToken`. Add a short callout: "note: tokens are opaque, treat them as strings".

alex: also a tiny link fix — the pagination top-level doc points to the old backoff guide. Replace with https://docs.redwood.ai/concepts/streaming-retries.

maria: @doc-wg can we get a docs reviewer for the language changes? I can self-review but would like a docs-dev eyes on phrasing.

doc-wg: happy to review — ping me when PR is up. We prefer sample length <= 12 lines and explicit mention of transient vs permanent errors.

sam: PR will include: Python/TS/Go snippets updated, brief backoff helper, one line about token opaqueness, link fix, and a tiny integration test pseudo-snippet. I'll open it in ~30m.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview created: https://preview.redwood.ai/pr-482 (available in ~5min) :rocket:

maria: awesome, once preview is up I'll skim and sign off. can we also add a changelog note under "SDK snippets"? small entry: "clarify resume token and add resilient backoff examples".

alex: perfect — thanks all. Will coordinate follow-ups if preview shows formatting glitches. :thumbsup: 

sam: PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/482 (draft). tagging reviewers: @maria @toni @doc-wg.

maria: saw preview — minor spacing nit in the JS snippet, will post a line comment.

alex: resolved?

maria: yep resolved, LGTM.

alex: merged and deployed docs. Thanks team! :tada:
